verdict.rationale: Lambda documents a REST Cloud API (with an OpenAPI spec) to create and manage resources and to launch instances programmatically. Cloud-init at launch time plus SSH lets an agent run a workload without the console. However, explicit API teardown and instance-level monitoring are not documented in the pack, and the only CLI/MCP path is an unofficial community project that handles launch and terminate. Missing for 10: explicitly documented terminate/teardown endpoint, API-accessible instance health/GPU monitoring (DCGM/Grafana is only shown for MK8s), an official CLI or MCP server, and hands-on corroboration of a full end-to-end agent lifecycle.
